description: This file defines the generic class `StreamCheckpoint<TState>` used for managing stream checkpoints in the Orleans framework, including properties for checkpoint data, methods for checking duplicates, and updating start tokens.

classes.name: StreamCheckpoint<TState>
classes.description: Generic class for managing stream checkpoint data, including stream identifiers, tokens, and an accumulator.

methods.name: RecoveryToken
methods.description: Property returning the last processed token or the start token if none processed.

methods.name: IsDuplicate
methods.description: Determines if a given sequence token is a duplicate based on the last processed token and start token.

methods.name: TryUpdateStartToken
methods.description: Attempts to set the start token if it is currently null.
